title: confluence-sync mapping
description: Maps repository Markdown files to existing Confluence pages.

baseUrl.description: Confluence base URL including /wiki, e.g. https://your-site.atlassian.net/wiki. Can be overridden by the base-url input.

file.description: Markdown path relative to the repository root.

pageId.description: Id of an existing Confluence page (the number in its URL).

title.description: Page title to set. When omitted the page keeps its current title.

parent.description: Where the page belongs in the page tree: another mapped Markdown file, or a Confluence page id. The page is moved under it if it is elsewhere.
